_note: Config for scripts/anchor_inspect.py: select the frozen 45 anchor items (configs/anchor_set_ids.json) out of a run's outputs for the manual inspection of supervisor item A4. Selection only - no metric is recomputed, so a dump's numbers are the evaluator's own. ADR 0032.
_csv_metric_columns_note: The per-item columns the review CSV carries after question / gold / prediction. They are a READING ORDER, not a metric definition: every one of them is a column scripts/musique_decompositions_evaluator.py already wrote into the per-item file. The six suite terms of ADR 0029 come first (break_exact_match, sari, ged, chain_validity, hop_count_exact_match, plus the over/under pair kept split and never summed), then the string-level columns that predate them, then the step counts that explain a hop-count miss. Adding or removing one changes what Jahid reads, not what anything scores.
